title: Animation Studio proposed contract bundle v0.1.0
description: Proposal only. Root accepts one project, characterRef, scene, shot, action, revision, or validationReport document. Not an animation executor.

frameRange.description: Scene-local integer frames, zero-based, half-open [start,end). Semantic check: end > start.

rotationXyzw.description: Unit quaternion x,y,z,w. Normalization is a semantic check.

transform.description: World space, meters, right-handed Z-up, character forward +Y, except attachment localTransform is parent-socket relative.

assetRef.description: Hash exact bytes before decoding. URI is project-relative. Rigged assets require selected profile; nonrigged assets use null (semantic check).

rotationXyzw.description: Unit quaternion x,y,z,w. Normalization is a semantic check.

localBox.description: Box in the owning entity local coordinates. Not a collision mesh.

localRotationXyzw.description: Unit quaternion x,y,z,w. Normalization is a semantic check.
Unit quaternion x,y,z,w. Normalization is a semantic check.
Unit quaternion x,y,z,w. Normalization is a semantic check.

attachment.description: Transform parent, distinct from logical ownership. localTransform is relative to named parent socket.
